page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-48-lssd is a member of the c4d server family, utilizing the x86_64 CPU architecture. This server configuration provides 48 dedicated vCPUs and 378.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include GPU accelerators, and the local storage size is designated as none. Additionally, it does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a memory allocation of nearly 8 GB per dedicated vCPU, this configuration aligns with memory-optimized resource profiles. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that workloads do not experience resource contention from neighboring tenants, providing predictable compute performance. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density relative to the vCPU count makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel GPU processing or local physical storage volumes.

The hardware profile of this server is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity. The absence of local storage and GPU hardware limits its application in high-performance local storage-bound databases or deep learning training, directing its utility toward network-attached storage architectures and memory-bound CPU tasks.
